question: Can you use CytoConverter genomic coordinates to calculate the frequency of chromosomal gains and losses across a cohort of breast cancer (morphology='3111') and adenocarcinoma (topology='0401') samples? Concretely, please include the number and frequency (2 decimals in percentage) of amplifications (gains of more than 1 copy), gains (1 extra copy), losses (1 copy) and homozygous deletions (loss of 2 copies) for each chromosomal band. And sort the result by the ordinal of each chromosome and the starting-ending base-pair position of each band in ascending order.
sql:
WITH filtered_cyto AS (
    SELECT c.RefNo, c.CaseNo, c.InvNo, c.Clone, c.Chr, c.ChrOrd, c.Start, c.End, c.Type, c.CellsPresent
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` cy ON c.RefNo = cy.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = cy.CaseNo
    WHERE (cy.Morph = '3111' OR cy.Topo = '0401')
)
SELECT 
    cyb.chromosome,
    cyb.cytoband_name,
    cyb.hg38_start,
    cyb.hg38_stop,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fc.Type = 'Gain' THEN fc.CaseNo END) as gain_cases,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fc.Type = 'Loss' THEN fc.CaseNo END) as loss_cases
FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cyb
LEFT JOIN filtered_cyto fc ON fc.Chr = cyb.chromosome 
    AND fc.Start < cyb.hg38_stop 
    AND fc.End > cyb.hg38_start
WHERE cyb.chromosome = 'chr1'
GROUP BY cyb.chromosome, cyb.cytoband_name, cyb.hg38_start, cyb.hg38_stop
ORDER BY cyb.hg38_start
LIMIT 15
